description: backup.prune without dryRun plans (the same plan the dry run would have shown) and then APPLIES it through the fence — the one remover, which deletes its own names only, inside the configured dirs. The act is recorded on the ledger (kind prune, the count in the fixed-template detail) and the backup.pruned event fires because at least one file went: the event the pre-migration hook's post-success prune pointed at. removed names the files by their names — the basenames, the fence's own voice.
